title: Stack more levels: how to get general and human-like Mario playing
abstract: arXiv:2611.16175v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Super Mario Bros. is widely used in game AI and procedural content generation (PCG), yet it remains unclear whether a model-free agent can reliably win unseen levels. To address this question, we train Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) agents on increasingly large sets of PCG-generated Mario levels and evaluate their generalization on 1000 held-out test levels. We then shape competent PPO policies into three gameplay archetypes---runner, killer, and collector. Finally, we fine-tune these PPO policies using Diffusion-Reward Adversarial Imitation Learning (DRAIL) with human gameplay demonstrations. We find that increasing the number of distinct PCG-generated training levels generally improves unseen-level performance, and that fine-tuning PPO policies with DRAIL increases action-level human-likeness while preserving much of the persona induced by PPO pretraining.

translated_title: 堆叠更多关卡：如何获得泛化且类人的马里奥玩家
translated_abstract: 《超级马里奥兄弟》被广泛应用于游戏人工智能和程序化内容生成（PCG）领域，但目前尚不清楚无模型智能体能否可靠地通关未见过的关卡。为了解答这一问题，我们在规模不断扩大的PCG生成的马里奥关卡集合上训练近端策略优化（PPO）智能体，并在1000个保留的测试关卡上评估其泛化能力。随后，我们将已具备能力的PPO策略塑造成三种游戏玩法原型——奔跑者、击杀者和收集者。最后，我们使用带有人类游戏演示的扩散奖励对抗模仿学习（DRAIL）对这些PPO策略进行微调。我们发现，增加不同的PCG生成训练关卡的数量通常能够提升智能体在未见关卡上的表现，并且使用DRAIL对PPO策略进行微调可以在保留PPO预训练所诱导的大部分角色特性的同时，提高动作层面的类人程度。
tldr: 通过在更多PCG生成的关卡上训练PPO智能体，并使用基于人类演示的DRAIL进行微调，可以同时提升马里奥智能体对未见关卡的泛化能力和行为的类人程度。
en_tdlr: Training PPO agents on larger sets of PCG-generated Mario levels improves generalization to unseen levels, and fine-tuning with DRAIL using human demonstrations increases action-level human-likeness while preserving the personas induced by pretraining.
